listitem.para: Norm value or range minimum value (double).
Norm type (double, NORM_1, NORM_2, NORM_INF or NORM_MINMAX).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: normalize normalizes an image or a histogram, so that the image or histogram has a specified norm or range.
There are two modes of normalization, depending on normType argument:

itemizedlist.member: when set NORM_1, NORM_2or NORM_INF, the norm (1, 2, inf) of the image is normalized to alpha.
when set to NORM_MINMAX the range of the pixel values are normalized to minimal value alpha and maximal value beta.
